coordinate_notes: All rects are absolute canvas-space visible bounding boxes, not local parent positions. Background-feature boxes are measured from the baked shared board; foreground uses compose placements plus alpha bounds where available. Organic painted edges are anti-aliased; measured boxes may vary 1–3px with alpha threshold. Partially occluded birds use only visible fragments. Parent is semantic; many child bounds overlap. z values describe visual stacking, not duplicate draw instructions. All board children are already baked into board_dimmed.png. No independent dim layer.

elements.notes: Use board_dimmed.png unchanged, full canvas. All rectangles are absolute canvas pixels, top-left origin; bounds exclude fully transparent pixels. Do not apply another dim overlay. Children document baked visual features, not additional sprites.
